Bill.BriefDescription: Recognizing that the use of certain land in Tacoma for school purposes is valid and meets the requirements of section 2, chapter 123, Laws of 1907.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to certain lands in Tacoma used for school andplayground purposes; creating new sections; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that in 1907, bylegislative enactment, the state of Washington dedicated certain landswithin the city of Tacoma for street, park, and boulevard purposes, andprovided that the interest would revert to the state in the event thelands were used for other purposes. The legislature further finds thata portion of such lands is adjacent to Jefferson elementary school, andthat Tacoma public schools, by permission from the city of Tacoma, hasutilized these lands for park and playground purposes in conjunctionwith the operation of the school. The legislature further finds thatTacoma public schools plan to renovate the elementary school, and thatthe renovation will result in a small portion of the footprint of theschool buildings being located on the abovementioned lands dedicatedby the state to the city of Tacoma. Tacoma public schools haverequested that the city of Tacoma approve a street vacation of theselands to further this renovation, and that the legislature declare thatthe reversionary provision in the 1907 legislation not be applicable to p. 1 SB 5088this renovation. The legislature finds that the renovation and uses ofthe lands dedicated to the city of Tacoma is fully consistent with thepurposes of the dedication in 1907, that public access and recreationaluse of the school playgrounds will continue to be provided, and thatthis act is necessary to ensure that the reversionary provision in theenactment is not applicable to uses of these lands.

The city of Tacoma or its successor ininterest, including Tacoma public schools, may use the lands describedas block 279, being a part of school section 36, township 21 north,range 2 east Willamette Meridian, as shown on the amended map of secondschool land addition to the city of Tacoma referenced in section 2,chapter 123, Laws of 1907, for public school purposes. The city ofTacoma may vacate all or a portion of the street bordering such landsfor school purposes. Any reversionary interest declared in section 2,chapter 123, Laws of 1907 is extinguished to the extent that such landsare used for public school purposes or other purposes under thedeclaration of such 1907 legislative enactment.
This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectimmediately.
